name: Saturn

albedo.title: Original RGB Saturn global map
albedo.credit: Li, West, Jiang, Knowles (2023), DOI 10.17189/rkkb-6y30; NASA/JPL/Cassini ISS
albedo.rights: NASA PDS science data; attribution retained
albedo.processing: Original RGB FITS 3601x1801; black ring-shadow and polar gaps linearly filled in latitude, with reconstruction mask retained; no generated turbulence
albedo.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: North-up verified against PDS browse graticule. West 360..0 converted to east -180..180 by 180-degree wrap. Not current cloud longitude.

ringProfile.provider: NASA PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node / Voyager 2 UVS
ringProfile.title: US1P01 normal optical depth, delta Sco egress
ringProfile.credit: NASA Voyager UVS / PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node
ringProfile.processing: Column 4 normal optical depth. Original 5km grid; negative estimates clipped to zero; opaque flag 99 capped at tau 6; interpolated onto 8192 radial texels. UV optical depth is an approximate visible-opacity proxy, not measured visible reflectance.

visualEnhancements: VISUAL_ENHANCEMENT: neutral warm ice color and approximate single-scattering ring photometry, no Bloom
VISUAL_ENHANCEMENT: ring brightness inspection gain switch, analytic sphere/plane mutual shadows
limitations: 2011 Saturn storm/cloud snapshot and 1981 ring occultation, not current weather
RECONSTRUCTED black-image gaps: 17.66% of map, latitude interpolation and constant polar extension
UVS tau is a proxy for visible optical opacity; opaque limits capped at 6, no particle-scale model
A/B/C main rings only, radial structures azimuthally averaged; no satellites or ring dynamics
Existing mean-radius sphere retained; Saturn oblateness and oblate shadow shape remain unresolved
